subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should maintainers close this stale macOS onboarding branch as superseded by the later automatic local Gateway setup work, or sponsor a narrower rebased follow-up for the remaining security-notice UX?
rationale: The PR has a protected maintainer label, overlaps a newer merged setup path, and still changes security/auth/onboarding behavior in ways that need explicit owner judgment before any repair or close action.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this branch because current main already owns the local Gateway setup direction and this PR still has security, auth-upgrade, UX, and proof blockers.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow follow-up
options.body: Keep only the remaining security-notice or copy improvements in a fresh branch based on current main, with the probe/auth changes removed or redesigned.

options.title: Ask contributor to repair this PR
options.body: Require a rebase, fixes for the security/auth/UX findings, and real macOS onboarding proof before further merge consideration.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this branch because current main already owns the local Gateway setup direction and this PR still has security, auth-upgrade, UX, and proof blockers.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` authored the newer merged macOS local Gateway setup PR that explicitly references this branch and is best positioned to decide whether any unique remainder should survive.
